Change c0441. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. V; 1831 Ch. XXII.

Context before (unchanged): The tranquillity which I now enjoyed did not endure.

1818 text: Memory brought madness with it; and when I thought on what had passed, a real insanity possessed me; sometimes I was furious, and burnt with rage, sometimes low and despondent. I neither spoke or looked, but sat motionless, bewildered by the multitude of miseries that overcame me.

1831 text: Memory brought madness with it; and when I thought of what had passed, a real insanity possessed me; sometimes I was furious, and burnt with rage; sometimes low and despondent. I neither spoke, nor looked at any one, but sat motionless, bewildered by the multitude of miseries that overcame me.

Diff: Memory brought madness with it; and when I thought [-on-] {+of+} what had passed, a real insanity possessed me; sometimes I was furious, and burnt with rage [-,-] {+;+} sometimes low and despondent. I neither spoke [-or-] {+, nor+} looked {+at any one+} , but sat motionless, bewildered by the multitude of miseries that overcame me.

Context after (unchanged): Elizabeth alone had the power to draw me from these fits; her gentle voice would soothe me when transported by passion, and inspire me with human feelings when sunk in torpor.

result.rationale: Mostly small rewordings: 'on' becomes 'of', 'or looked' becomes ', nor looked at any one', and punctuation is adjusted. The added 'at any one' slightly extends the sense of withdrawal, but no event, character, or judgment changes.
